title: Look It Up: Analysing Internal Web Search Capabilities of Modern LLMs
why_relevant: Introduces a benchmark assessing when LLMs decide to invoke web search vs rely on parametric knowledge, measuring confidence calibration, selective retrieval, and accuracy gains—directly relevant to calibration/control of retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on commercial models' built-in web search rather than general RAG pipelines; limited to factual QA.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
